instruction: Configure Comic Sans MS as the default font for LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font in LibreOffice Writer to Comic Sans MS. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu configuration file to verify the default font setting has been changed to 'Comic Sans MS'. This uses the existing find_default_font metric function.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if default font is set to Comic Sans MS, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches LibreOffice configuration file at /home/user/.config/libreoffice/4/user/registrymodifications.xcu
Metric function find_default_font properly parses XML configuration and extracts the default font setting from /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont/Standard path
Expected value 'Comic Sans MS' correctly matches the instruction requirement
Evaluator logic can semantically verify that the default font was changed to Comic Sans MS
Configuration file is persistent and accessible after task completion - no postconfig needed
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor note: The metric checks the 'Standard' font under DefaultFont, which is appropriate for the default paragraph font in LibreOffice Writer. This is the correct interpretation of 'default font' in the instruction context.
